portfolio.name: portfolio
limits: Read-only personal holdings. Not part of either paper book and not a copied trader.
Combined total is Solana wallet marked value plus priced fomo positions.
Fomo marks use Dexscreener under the $5K quote-side liquidity rule (ETH/WETH via CoinGecko).
The two addresses are distinct; holdings are not double-counted.

wallet.name: wallet
limits: Read-only public RPC + Dexscreener; this wallet is never copied into the paper books and nothing is signed.
Value history starts at the first dashboard snapshot (no historical backfill).
USD total includes only holdings with a liquid Dexscreener pool (same $5K quote-side rule as paper marks); unpriced tokens are listed but not valued.
Native SOL is the system-account spendable balance (rent locked in token accounts is not included).
Recent swaps are inferred from on-chain token deltas on the last 15 signatures and can miss complex routes.
Public RPCs may rate-limit; a failed fetch keeps the last snapshot and flags the view as stale.

fomo_account.name: fomo_account
limits: Read-only. This account is not a copied trader in either paper book.
24H / 7D / 30D chart PnL is not exposed on the profile/balances endpoints used here.
Open positions come from the fomo balances API and are marked with Dexscreener under the same $5K quote-side rule as paper marks (ETH/WETH uses CoinGecko).
Fomo equity is the sum of those priced positions only; unpriced rows are listed but not included.
other_pnl is the API’s otherPnl field (not current holdings value, and not a 24h change).
